name: Organic Honeycrisp Apples
description: Crispy, naturally sweet organic apples packed with dietary fiber, vitamin C, and antioxidants from orchard harvests.
storageTip: Store in a cool dry crisper drawer to maintain snap for up to 3 weeks.

name: Vine-Ripened Heirloom Tomatoes
description: Sweet, juicy field tomatoes bursting with savory flavor, rich in natural lycopene and vitamin A.
storageTip: Keep at room temperature away from direct sunlight for the best aroma and texture.

name: Crisp Farm Baby Spinach
description: Tender, vibrant dark-green leaves carefully harvested in early dawn, loaded with iron, lutein, and folate.
storageTip: Wrap in a dry paper towel and refrigerate in an airtight container to keep crisp.

name: Sweet Crunchy Root Carrots
description: Earthy, firm carrots harvested with greens intact, naturally sweet and packed with eyesight-boosting beta-carotene.
storageTip: Trim green tops before storing in the vegetable drawer to retain natural sweetness.

name: Fresh Field Strawberries
description: Aromatic ruby-red berries picked fresh at morning dew, packed with polyphenols, manganese, and vitamin C.
storageTip: Do not wash until immediately before serving; store chilled in original breathable box.

name: Aromatic Sweet Basil
description: Fragrant sweet Italian and Mediterranean basil leaves, rich in essential oils, ideal for pestos, salads, and pasta.
storageTip: Treat like freshly cut flowers in a cup of water at room temperature.

name: Invigorating Garden Mint
description: Crisp and cooling spearmint and peppermint shoots, perfect for revitalizing teas, lemonades, chutneys, and garnishes.
storageTip: Wrap loosely in damp kitchen cloth and refrigerate.

name: Grass-Fed Farm Whole Milk
description: Wholesome, pure unpasteurized morning farm milk with thick golden cream layer, free from synthetic hormones or additives.
storageTip: Store between 2°C and 4°C in the coldest middle section of the refrigerator.

name: Artisanal Farmhouse Cheese
description: Aged natural farmhouse cheese handmade in small wheels using traditional rennet and grass-fed dairy cow milk.
storageTip: Wrap in parchment paper or cheese paper rather than plastic wrap to let it breathe.
